ios.desc:
Tired of surprise charges from subscriptions you forgot about? SubscriptionCat is the subscription tracker and bill reminder that keeps you in control of your recurring expenses.

ADD YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS ONCE
Track every subscription — streaming services, software tools, memberships, and more — in one place. No bank account connection required. Your data stays on your device.

NEVER MISS A RENEWAL
Get reminders before any subscription renews so you can decide whether to keep it or cancel. SubscriptionCat alerts you in advance, giving you time to act.

SPOT WASTE INSTANTLY
See your total monthly subscription spending at a glance. Quickly identify services you no longer use and open their official cancellation pages directly from the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
SubscriptionCat is a subscription manager that works entirely on your device. No account needed, no financial data collected, no surprises.

SIMPLE ONE-TIME PRICING
Pay once and track subscriptions forever. No subscription needed to manage your subscriptions.

Whether you're trying to cut expenses, manage recurring bills, or simply stay aware of your monthly spending — SubscriptionCat keeps everything organized.

quotes.text: Got charged for services I forgot about. Finding the cancellation pages was the most annoying part — companies deliberately bury them.Started collecting them manually. 1,000+ verified direct cancellation URLs across SaaS tools, streaming services and apps. Made it into a free searchable page and also an iOS app that tracks subscriptions and reminds you before renewals.You can also submit missing services directly and I'm working on a public API for the search endpoint. website url: subscriptioncat.space/search
